text: In the quiet suburb of Bailey Downs, morbid teenage sisters Brigitte and Ginger once swore to leave or die together by sixteen. The night [Ginger gets her first period|trigger|the body changing], the creature mauling the town's dogs bites her, and soon she [sprouts a tail and hair grows from her scars|rules|the body changes]. As Ginger grows savage and hungry, Brigitte hunts for [a cure in a monkshood extract|rules|it can be undone] and [cuts her own palm to share her sister's blood|who_suffers|families and parents].
